When you buy tickets for someone, it's generally considered a gift or an act of kindness, and asking them to pay you back can come across as impolite or inconsiderate. It's better to either clearly communicate that you're buying the tickets with the expectation of being reimbursed or to make it clear that it's a gift and they don't need to pay you back. Asking someone to Venmo you after the fact can put them in an awkward position and may damage your relationship.
